bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears enter their Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Detroit Lions dealing with injury concerns, as Elijah Hicks has been ruled out for the Lions game, while Kyler Gordon is still not practicing , prompting the team to bolster its secondary depth. In a related move, the Chicago Bears have claimed defensive back Isaac Yiadom off waivers, the team announced on Tuesday , a signal that Gordon's shoulder injury could keep him sidelined again for the high-stakes NFC North matchup.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions, currently 8-2 and preparing to host the Chicago Bears on Thanksgiving, are dealing with a tough injury report as fans got their first look at the Thanksgiving injury report Monday night, and it wasn't kind to the defense, with Chuck Clark and DJ Wonnum among four defenders missing practice . This comes on top of a brutal stretch of injuries for Detroit, as just one week ago the Lions lost their best defensive player, Aidan Hutchinson, to a fluke season-ending injury suffered while celebrating a sack of Patriots quarterback Drake Maye , leaving the team searching for reinforcements ahead of a pivotal divisional showdown.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story is the return of star edge rusher Micah Parsons, who was officially activated to the Packers' 53-man roster from the PUP list and was cleared to play Wednesday night when Green Bay visits the Los Angeles Rams . Parsons shared an emotional message ahead of his return, while the Packers also deal with a banged-up offensive line, as starters Sean Rhyan and Kevin Zeitler are questionable, meaning the Packers might be playing with a makeshift offensive line against a stout Rams defense Wednesday .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings fell to 7-3 after a lopsided 35-10 loss to the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City during Week 11, a defeat that has fueled criticism of head coach Kevin O'Connell and defensive coordinator Brian Flores ahead of their Week 12 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons. In the aftermath, Minnesota made roster moves including releasing linebacker Josh Ross and re-signing Tristan Leigh to the practice squad, while also parting ways with Odell Beckham Jr.
